# hivenest -- hive nest (episode 2 spawner of mothlings, box 48 x 48)
# generated by tools/sprites/build.py -- do not edit by hand
# anchor = bottom centre of the box (the mound and its roots on the ground line)
# glow: amber openings, lime spots, motes and the crown burst
frame 96 96
anchor 48 92
# idle: breathing: the mound swells, openings throb in turn, glowing motes drift out
anim idle 8 loop 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7
# attack: release: openings flare (0-3), the crown bursts (3-6), settles (7)
anim attack 12 loop 8 9 10 11 12 13 14 15
# hurt: shudders, glow dims
anim hurt 14 loop 16 17 18
